derivations_audited.notes: Proof uses strict concavity of Shannon entropy and monotonicity of the natural logarithm. Equality conditions JSD=0 iff P=Q and JSD=ln 2 iff P perp Q are mathematically exact.
Bounds 0.5 ||P-Q||_TV^2 <= JSD <= ln(2) ||P-Q||_TV verified under natural log convention (nats) and standard 1-norm TV distance.
Local expansion ds_FR^2 = 8 * JSD + O(||dP||^3) matches Riemannian curvature on statistical manifold.
Self-gradient dw_m/dJSD_m = -beta w_m(1 - w_m) < 0 and cross-gradient dw_m/dJSD_j = beta w_m w_j > 0 derived correctly via partition function differentiation.
